# Third-party licenses

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask gen-credits` from crates/mica-gui/assets/credits/crates.tsv. Do not edit. -->

The 591 Rust crates Mica Slicer's app and command line use on any platform, generated from Cargo's dependency data, with each crate's license and copyright notice. The full license texts are in [`crates/mica-gui/assets/credits/licenses/`](crates/mica-gui/assets/credits/licenses/). The projects, ideas and assets Mica is built on are listed in [`THIRD_PARTY.md`](THIRD_PARTY.md) and [`PROVENANCE.md`](PROVENANCE.md). The same lists are in the app under About Mica Slicer › Credits and Open-source licenses.
